title: New Shores model recipe
description: One kit-bashed model per content ID (ART_DIRECTION §7). Coordinates are in tiles (1 tile = 4 m) in recipe space: Blender axes, z up, origin at the footprint's ground centre, the front edge (the door at rotation 0) toward +y; ships: bow toward +x, origin at the waterline centre. Rotations are XYZ Euler angles in degrees. The footprint is read from content/old_coast, never repeated here. Validated by assets/build/nsassets/schema.py (stdlib subset of JSON Schema: type, enum, const, required, properties, additionalProperties, items, minItems, maxItems, minimum, maximum, exclusiveMinimum, pattern, minLength, $ref, oneOf).

notes.description: What the model shows; production buildings name their signature prop.

parts.description: Parts shared by every variant and level.

variants.description: Variant n (file <id>.v<n>.glb) = parts + variants[n]. Houses have exactly 3.

attachments.description: Separately exported parts drawn on top of the model (<id>.<name>.glb).

budget_exception.description: Doubles the building budget; only warehouse, shipyard, chapel and market_small.

role.description: A colour name of the buildings, terrain, fields or water group of assets/palette.json.

part.description: A kit piece (kit + file) or a procedural primitive (prim + its parameters), placed by position/rotation/scale.

name.description: Label in error messages (default: file or prim and the index).

file.description: Kit-relative path as listed in assets/kits/MANIFEST.json.

size.description: box: x y z (base centred at z = 0); wedge: ridge length x, depth y, height z; rock: radii x y z.

caps.description: cylinder: draw the top and bottom caps (default: top only).

open.description: box: faces left out (unseen faces cost triangles).

hip.description: wedge: hip inset of both ridge ends (0 = gable roof).

width_top.description: sail: top width (0 = triangle; default = width).

bulge.description: sail: depth of the wind belly toward +y.

profile.description: lathe: (radius, z) points from bottom to top, revolved about z.

rotate.description: Extra rotation about z (degrees) per copy.

repeat.description: Copies the part count times, each moved by step (tiles, recipe space) from the previous.

role.description: Colour of the whole part (required for primitives).

shade.description: Replaces the kit default shade (times the part shade and, for gradient atlases, the band shade).

roles.description: Kit material name (atlas kits: Atlas/<swatch>; gradient atlases also Atlas/<swatch>@<band>, band 0 = light … 2 = dark) → role or {role, shade}; other materials keep the kit default.

drop.description: Kit pieces: materials left out (e.g. Atlas/stone to strip a KayKit plinth; gradient atlases by swatch or swatch@band).

dissolve.description: Planar decimation angle limit (degrees), material borders kept.

collapse.description: Edge-collapse ratio of the remaining triangles.

simplify.description: Mesh simplification of a kit piece (dissolve first, then collapse).

crop.description: Kit pieces: keeps only the triangles whose centroid lies in this box (kit units, Blender axes, before any transform) — takes a part of a piece.

lod.description: Detail level: full = only in the full model, lite = only in the lite model (absent: both). A file with any lod part is also exported as <file>.lite.glb, drawn by the client at the near-LOD default zoom (dense towns stay inside the software-rendering budget); the full model is drawn when zoomed in.
